what_this_measures: The realized two-sided size of the INV-NULL v3 decision rule USING THE CONSTANTS AS THEY APPEAR IN amendment_v3.yaml. The constants were read back out of that file with yaml.safe_load, type-asserted to be floats, and scored on validation draws INDEPENDENT of the calibration draws that produced them. This is the check VF-1 exists to force: a rule is only as calibrated as its encoding.
boundary: TOY. No HQC object was constructed, no measurement arm was run, and no log2_A_k was computed on any space-(T) arm. Every draw is from S ~ Binomial(n_e, q_hat) under the declared null. Nothing here is a statement about HQC, assumption A17 or A5, any decoding-failure rate, or any standardized parameter set.

roundtrip.method: every constant emitted through yf(); asserted to satisfy float(str)==value AND yaml.safe_load(str) is a float equal to the value; the whole table was re-read after injection and compared bit-for-bit against the in-memory values

v2_comparison.note: amendment_v2.yaml's transcribed constants at k=2, measured by validator TASK-20260806-301f68 on 1e6 fresh draws per cell
